import importlib.util, os, secrets, subprocess
from pathlib import Path
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('controller', 'scripts/live-ci-controller.py')

spec.loader.exec_module(m)
host = 'root@aspen1.local'
data = m.settings(host)
assert data['root'] == '/var/tmp/kiln-live-ci-20261018'
for component in ('github', 'proxy', 'https'):
    assert m.remote(host, 'systemctl show kiln-live-controller-' + component + '.service -p ActiveState --value').strip() == b'inactive'
m.remote(host, "test ! -L /var/tmp/kiln-live-ci-20261018 && test \"$(stat -c %a /var/tmp/kiln-live-ci-20261018)\" = 700".replace('\"','"'))
token = subprocess.run(['gh', 'auth', 'token'], check=True, stdout=subprocess.PIPE).stdout.strip()
assert token and b'\n' not in token
handoff = Path('/var/tmp/kiln-live-ci-inputs-20261018/webhook-secret')
parent = handoff.parent.stat()
assert parent.st_uid == os.getuid() and parent.st_mode & 0o077 == 0
webhook = secrets.token_hex(32).encode()
fd = os.open(handoff, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL, 0o600)
with os.fdopen(fd, 'wb') as output:
    output.write(webhook)
m.put(host, 'secrets/.secrets/kiln-live/default/STATUS_TOKEN', token)
m.put(host, 'secrets/.secrets/kiln-live/default/WEBHOOK_SECRET', webhook)

m.save_settings(host, data)
